items.text:
Awful character creator that will see you lose your entire character due to BS RNG. Only to grind out a souless existance to scrape enough money together from tonnes of garbage to spend 5,000 dollars on a 24 hour pass to salvage said trash without massive fines\jailtime.

Oh, and the junk vendors do not buy most of the high ticket items unless you have a pass, and even then at extortionate rates.

New glitch just dropped where you cant even experience the game anymore as you will be spat out of the starting port faster than the speed of light (draining all fuel to stop making it impossible to return without cheats) , making you the first human to leave the solar system if only to retreat from this half baked mess.
items.text_zh:
糟糕的角色创建器，会让你因为扯淡的随机数生成而失去整个角色。只能苦苦熬过一段没有灵魂的生存，从成吨的垃圾里勉强攒够钱，花 5,000 美元买一张 24 小时通行证，才能去回收那些垃圾而不被巨额罚款\坐牢。

哦，还有，垃圾商贩不会买大多数高价物品，除非你有通行证，即便有，价格也是敲诈性的。

新 bug 刚刚上线，你甚至再也无法体验游戏了，因为你会以超光速被从起始港口喷出去（耗尽所有燃料，让你不可能不用作弊就返回），让你成为第一个离开太阳系的人类，哪怕只是为了逃离这半生不熟的烂摊子。

observations.description: 垃圾商人不购买高价物品，即使有通行证价格也过高
observations.evidence: the junk vendors do not buy most of the high ticket items unless you have a pass, and even then at extortionate rates
observations.evidence_zh: 而且，垃圾商贩不会收购大多数高价物品，除非你有通行证，即便有，价格也高得离谱
